entries.en: The gardener cleared the fallen leaves from around the water fennel.
entries.zh: 园丁清理了那株水芹周围的落叶。

entries.en: The water fern covered the corner of the pond beside the broken fountain.
entries.zh: 坏掉的喷泉旁，池塘的一角长满了满江红。

entries.en: A water hen stepped onto the floating board as our boat drifted closer.
entries.zh: 我们的船漂近时，一只水鸡踏上了漂浮的木板。

entries.en: The caretaker removed a plastic wrapper caught among the water hyacinth.
entries.zh: 管理员取走了缠在水葫芦丛中的一片塑料包装。

entries.en: The water lettuce drifted against the side of the abandoned boat.
entries.zh: 水浮莲漂到了那艘弃船的船边。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the water lobelia after moving a fallen twig aside.
entries.zh: 植物学家把落下的小树枝拨开后，拍下了那株水生半边莲。

entries.en: The groundskeeper placed a support beneath the damaged branch of the water locust.
entries.zh: 场地管理员在水生皂荚那根受损的树枝下放了支撑物。

entries.en: A forgotten garden glove lay beneath the water mint beside the path.
entries.zh: 一只被遗忘的园艺手套躺在小路旁的水薄荷下面。

entries.en: The farmer led the water ox away from the open gate.
entries.zh: 农民把那头水牛从敞开的大门旁牵走了。

entries.en: She knelt beside the water pimpernel to retrieve her dropped lens cap.
entries.zh: 为了捡回掉落的镜头盖，她跪在水茴草旁。

entries.en: The cleaner returned the unopened bag of water softener to the supply cupboard.
entries.zh: 清洁工把那袋未拆封的水软化剂放回了用品柜。

entries.en: The water spaniel shook itself before climbing into the back of our car.
entries.zh: 那只水猎狗抖了抖身子，才爬进我们汽车的后部。

entries.en: The surveyor marked the water speedwell's position before the drainage work began.
entries.zh: 排水施工开始前，测量员标出了那株水苦荬的位置。

entries.en: The microscope image showed a water stoma near the edge of the leaf.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像显示，叶片边缘附近有一个水孔。

entries.en: A water strider moved across the puddle beside the fallen sign.
entries.zh: 一只水黾科昆虫在倒下的标牌旁的水洼表面移动。

entries.en: The water thrush hopped behind a root just as I focused the camera.
entries.zh: 我刚把相机对好焦，那只水鸫就跳到了一条树根后面。

entries.en: The water turkey remained on the branch while the fishing boat passed below.
entries.zh: 渔船从下方驶过时，那只蛇鹈仍停在树枝上。

entries.en: The damaged pipe released water vapour into the roof space.
entries.zh: 破损的管道把水汽排进了屋顶夹层。

entries.meaningZh: 水管系〔棘皮动物的器官系统〕
entries.en: The class traced the starfish's water vascular system on a transparent model.
entries.zh: 学生们在透明模型上顺着海星水管系的走向察看。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the test for the water-soluble vitamin in the stored sample.
entries.zh: 实验室重新检测了储存样品中的那种水溶性维生素。

entries.en: The researcher transferred the wax insect to a clean observation dish.
entries.zh: 研究员把那只白蜡虫移到了干净的观察皿中。

entries.en: A wax moth flew out when the beekeeper lifted the empty storage box.
entries.zh: 养蜂人抬起空储物箱时，一只大蜡螟飞了出来。

entries.en: The wax myrtle partly concealed the gate leading into the nursery.
entries.zh: 那株杨梅属植物遮住了通往苗圃的大门的一部分。

entries.en: The gardeners moved the temporary fence farther from the wax palm.
entries.zh: 园丁们把临时围栏移到了离蜡棕更远的地方。

entries.en: The wayfaring tree was undamaged, although the bench beside it had overturned.
entries.zh: 旁边的长凳虽已翻倒，那株绵毛荚蒾却没有受损。

entries.en: The web spinner slipped beneath a flake of bark before we could photograph it.
entries.zh: 我们还没来得及拍照，那只纺足目昆虫就钻到了一片树皮下面。

entries.en: The veterinarian gently examined the duck's injured webbed foot.
entries.zh: 兽医轻轻检查了那只鸭子受伤的蹼足。

entries.en: A child's red scarf hung from the weeping spruce beside the picnic area.
entries.zh: 野餐区旁的垂枝云杉上挂着一条孩子的红围巾。

entries.en: The farmer filled a bucket with well water and carried it to the shed.
entries.zh: 农民打了一桶井水，提到了棚屋那边。

entries.en: The photographer crouched beside the welted thistle to keep the road out of the picture.
entries.zh: 摄影师蹲在飞廉旁，避免把公路拍进画面。

entries.en: The western chimpanzee watched the keeper unlock the gate to the adjoining enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只西非黑猩猩看着饲养员打开通往相邻围栏区域的门锁。

entries.en: The western hemlock cast a long shadow over the empty parking space.
entries.zh: 那棵西部铁杉在空停车位上投下了一道长长的影子。

entries.en: The hikers rested beneath the western larch while waiting for the others.
entries.zh: 徒步者们在那棵西部落叶松下休息，等候其他人。

entries.en: A western meadowlark appeared on the fence after the tractor had passed.
entries.zh: 拖拉机驶过后，一只西美草地鹨出现在围栏上。

entries.en: The botanist found western ragweed growing through a crack in the abandoned yard.
entries.zh: 植物学家发现多年生豚草从废弃院子的一道裂缝里长了出来。

entries.en: The survey team measured the western red cedar beside the damaged footbridge.
entries.zh: 测量队测量了受损步行桥旁的那棵美国西部侧柏。

entries.en: The old western yellow pine stood just beyond the newly repaired fence.
entries.zh: 那棵老美国西部黄松就立在刚修好的围栏外面。

entries.en: The gardeners protected the western yew while digging a trench for the new cable.
entries.zh: 园丁们为新电缆挖沟时，保护好了那株短叶紫杉。

entries.en: A fallen branch from the Weymouth pine had damaged the greenhouse roof.
entries.zh: 美国五叶松的一根落枝砸坏了温室的屋顶。

entries.en: The whale shark swam beneath the research boat while the camera recorded.
entries.zh: 相机录像时，那条鲸鲨从研究船下方游过。

entries.en: The whalebone whale model occupied most of the museum's entrance hall.
entries.zh: 那具须鲸模型占据了博物馆门厅的大部分空间。

entries.meaningZh: 小麦杆黑粉病〔植物病害名〕
entries.en: The inspector collected a sample from the field affected by wheat flag smut.
entries.zh: 检查员从发生小麦杆黑粉病的田里采集了一份样品。

entries.en: The farmer postponed the sale until the suspected wheat rust had been investigated.
entries.zh: 农民推迟了出售，等对疑似小麦锈病的调查结束后再卖。

entries.en: The wheel bug paused on the empty collecting jar's lid.
entries.zh: 那只轮背猎蝽在空采集罐的盖子上停了下来。

entries.en: Before the wagon moved, the driver checked the wheel horse's harness.
entries.zh: 马车出发前，车夫检查了紧靠车身的那匹辕马的挽具。

entries.meaningZh: 带有环状花簇的树〔澳大利亚英语树名〕
entries.en: The wheel tree shaded the bench where the gardeners ate their lunch.
entries.zh: 园丁们吃午饭的长凳处在那棵带有环状花簇的树的树荫下。

entries.en: The whip scorpion retreated beneath the hollow log in its enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只鞭尾蝎退到了饲养箱中那段空心木头下面。

entries.en: A whirligig beetle circled the leaf floating beside the jetty.
entries.zh: 一只豉甲绕着码头旁那片漂浮的叶子打转。

entries.en: The whistling swan swam behind the reeds as our boat approached.
entries.zh: 我们的船靠近时，那只小天鹅游到了芦苇后面。

entries.en: A branch of the white alder brushed against the parked van's roof.
entries.zh: 白桤木的一根树枝拂过了停着的货车的车顶。

entries.en: The carpenter found a white ant inside the damaged door frame.
entries.zh: 木匠在受损的门框里发现了一只白蚁。

entries.en: The white bedstraw had grown through the spokes of an abandoned bicycle.
entries.zh: 白猪殃殃已经长进了一辆废弃自行车的辐条间。

entries.en: We found the missing glove beneath the white beech near the campsite.
entries.zh: 我们在营地附近那棵美洲山毛榉下找到了丢失的手套。

entries.en: The white broom remained in its pot until the builders had finished the path.
entries.zh: 施工人员铺好小路前，那株白金雀花一直留在花盆里。

entries.en: A strip of white clover separated the vegetable beds from the fence.
entries.zh: 一带白三叶草把菜畦与围栏隔开。

entries.en: The white croaker swam out of the camera's view behind a submerged marker.
entries.zh: 那条白姑鱼游到了水下标记后面，离开了相机的视野。

entries.en: She removed a piece of litter caught in the white dead nettle.
entries.zh: 她取走了挂在野芝麻上的一片垃圾。

entries.en: The white elm beside the old post office survived the storm.
entries.zh: 旧邮局旁的那棵美国榆挺过了这场暴风雨。

entries.en: The geologist photographed the white feldspar sample against a black background.
entries.zh: 地质学家以黑色为背景拍下了钠长石样品。

entries.en: The white fox watched the keeper remove a fallen branch from the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只白狐看着饲养员从围栏区域中移走一根落枝。

entries.en: The curator placed the white lead ore in a sealed display case.
entries.zh: 策展人把白铅矿放进了密封展柜。

entries.en: The restorer cut a narrow strip of white leather for the replacement strap.
entries.zh: 修复师裁下了一条窄矾鞣革，用来制作替换带。

entries.en: The mechanic inspected the white metal lining of the damaged bearing.
entries.zh: 机修工检查了受损轴承的白合金衬层。

entries.en: The white mulberry shaded the corner where we had parked our bicycles.
entries.zh: 我们停自行车的那个角落处在那棵桑树的树荫下。

entries.en: The carpenter chose white oak for the replacement cupboard doors.
entries.zh: 木匠选择用白栎木制作替换柜门。

entries.en: A great white pelican settled on the water beside the empty mooring.
entries.zh: 一只白鹈鹕落在了空泊位旁的水面上。

entries.meaningZh: 淡水石首鱼〔美国地区旧称〕
entries.en: The fisherman laid the white perch beside a wooden ruler on the boat.
entries.zh: 渔夫把那条淡水石首鱼放在船上的一把木尺旁。

entries.en: During the walk, I stopped beside the white pine to tighten a loose bootlace.
entries.zh: 徒步途中，我在那棵美国五针松旁停下，系紧一根松开的鞋带。

entries.en: The gardener untied the rope that had become caught in the white popinac.
entries.zh: 园丁解开了缠在银合欢上的绳子。

entries.en: A bicycle leaned against the white poplar outside the village shop.
entries.zh: 村里商店外的一棵白杨树旁靠着一辆自行车。

entries.en: The nursery separated the plants showing signs of white rust from the rest of the delivery.
entries.zh: 苗圃把出现白锈病迹象的植株与这批到货的其他植株分开了。

entries.en: The white shark circled the underwater camera before swimming beyond its view.
entries.zh: 那条噬人鲨绕水下相机转了一圈，才游出它的视野。

entries.en: The groundskeeper found a broken bench beneath the white spruce.
entries.zh: 场地管理员在白云杉下发现了一张坏掉的长凳。

entries.en: The white stork stepped aside as the keeper brought a bucket through the gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员提着桶穿过大门时，那只白鹳走到了一边。

entries.en: The white sturgeon swam beneath the footbridge as the visitors watched from above.
entries.zh: 游客们从上方观看时，那条高首鲟从步行桥下游过。

entries.en: She carried the white trumpet lily indoors after its pot cracked in the frost.
entries.zh: 花盆冻裂后，她把那株麝香百合搬进了屋里。

entries.en: A kite had become caught in the white walnut beside the playground.
entries.zh: 一只风筝挂在了游乐场旁的灰胡桃树上。

entries.en: The white whale approached the underwater window, then swam towards the far end of the pool.
entries.zh: 那只白鲸靠近水下观察窗，然后朝水池远端游去。

entries.en: The surveyor stood beneath the white willow while checking the boundary map.
entries.zh: 测量员站在白柳下核对地界图。

entries.en: The white-crowned sparrow perched on the open gate as we packed away the telescope.
entries.zh: 我们收起观鸟镜时，那只白冠麻雀停在敞开的大门上。

entries.en: The white-tailed deer paused at the edge of the clearing when the engine stopped.
entries.zh: 发动机停下时，那只白尾鹿在林间空地边缘停住了。

entries.en: A white-throated sparrow hopped onto the empty picnic table beside us.
entries.zh: 一只白喉带鹀跳上了我们旁边空着的野餐桌。

entries.en: The whooper swan swam out from behind the floating platform.
entries.zh: 那只大天鹅从漂浮平台后面游了出来。

entries.en: The keeper waited for the whooping crane to move before opening the inner gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员等那只鸣鹤走开后，才打开内侧的门。

entries.en: The widow bird remained visible on the branch after the other birds flew away.
entries.zh: 其他鸟飞走后，我们仍能看见树枝上的那只寡妇鸟。

entries.en: The gardener removed a plastic bag caught in the wig tree.
entries.zh: 园丁取走了挂在黄栌上的一个塑料袋。

entries.en: The wild apple beside the abandoned cottage had grown around an old fence post.
entries.zh: 弃屋旁的那棵野苹果已经绕着一根旧围栏柱长了起来。

entries.en: The wild ass walked away from the fence when the keeper approached with a broom.
entries.zh: 饲养员拿着扫帚走近时，那头野驴从围栏旁走开了。

entries.en: The botanist marked the wild cabbage's position before the path was repaired.
entries.zh: 修理小路前，植物学家标出了那株野生甘蓝的位置。

entries.en: A fallen twig lay across the wild carrot she wanted to photograph.
entries.zh: 一根落下的小树枝横压在她想拍摄的那株野胡萝卜上。

entries.en: The gardener left the wild chervil untouched while retrieving a lost key from beneath it.
entries.zh: 园丁从林峨参下面取回一把丢失的钥匙，没有碰动那株植物。

entries.en: The botanist compared the wild cotton with a cultivated plant in the adjoining plot.
entries.zh: 植物学家把野棉与相邻地块里的一株栽培植物作了比较。

entries.en: A wild dog crossed the track before our vehicle reached the bend.
entries.zh: 我们的车还没到弯道，一只野狗就穿过了车道。

entries.en: The wild duck swam past the landing stage as we untied the boat.
entries.zh: 我们解开船绳时，那只野鸭从登船平台旁游过。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the wild emmer before moving the temporary marker.
entries.zh: 研究员拍下了野生二粒小麦，才挪动临时标记。

entries.en: The old wild fig partly blocked the entrance to the abandoned garden.
entries.zh: 那棵老野生无花果树挡住了废弃花园入口的一部分。

entries.en: The gardener placed a barrier around the wild ginger while the wall was being repaired.
entries.zh: 修墙期间，园丁在杜衡周围设置了围挡。

entries.en: The wild horse watched us from the far side of the fence.
entries.zh: 那匹野马从围栏的另一侧望着我们。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the wild liquorice without disturbing the plants around it.
entries.zh: 植物学家拍摄了那株相思子，没有碰动它周围的植物。

entries.en: The survey team placed a small marker beside the patch of wild mustard.
entries.zh: 调查队在那片田芥菜旁放了一个小标记。

entries.en: A wild oat had taken root in the experimental plot's irrigation channel.
entries.zh: 试验地的灌溉沟里长出了一株野生燕麦。

entries.meaningZh: 青年时代的放荡行为〔比喻，常用于 sow one's wild oats〕
entries.en: At fifty, Leon still laughed about sowing his wild oats before he became a carpenter.
entries.zh: 五十岁时，利昂谈起当木匠前年轻时的放荡经历，仍然会笑。

entries.en: The wild ox walked towards the far gate as the keeper entered the enclosure.
entries.zh: 饲养员走进围栏区域时，那头野牛朝远处的大门走去。

entries.en: The gardener rescued the wild pansy from beneath the overturned wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 园丁把三色堇从翻倒的独轮手推车下面救了出来。

entries.en: The botanist moved the marker to avoid covering the wild pink.
entries.zh: 植物学家挪动了标记，避免遮住那株加罗林雪轮。

entries.en: The storm knocked the measuring pole down across the wild wheat.
entries.zh: 暴风雨把测量杆刮倒，压在了野生二粒小麦上。

entries.en: We tied the boat to the willow tree while checking the damaged jetty.
entries.zh: 检查损坏的码头时，我们把船系在了那棵柳树上。

entries.en: The entomologist examined the beetle's damaged wing case beneath a magnifying lamp.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在放大灯下检查了那只甲虫受损的翅鞘。

entries.en: The winged elm outside the library had lost a branch in the storm.
entries.zh: 图书馆外的翅榆在暴风雨中折了一根树枝。

entries.en: The gardener moved a fallen chair away from the winged spindle tree.
entries.zh: 园丁把倒下的椅子从那株卫矛旁移开了。

entries.en: The winter cherry stood beside the empty flowerpot on the greenhouse shelf.
entries.zh: 温室搁板上的那株酸浆立在空花盆旁。

entries.en: The builder protected the winter jasmine while replacing the window above it.
entries.zh: 施工人员更换上方的窗户时，保护好了下面的迎春花。

entries.en: She repositioned the lamp to photograph the winter rose without touching it.
entries.zh: 她调整了灯的位置，拍摄黑嚏根草，没有触碰那株植物。

entries.en: The gardener left the winter sweet undisturbed while repairing the path beside it.
entries.zh: 园丁修理旁边的小路时，没有碰动那株牛至。

entries.en: The glazier replaced the cracked wire glass in the workshop door.
entries.zh: 玻璃工更换了作坊门上开裂的嵌丝玻璃。

entries.en: The wolf cub hid behind a log when the keeper opened the gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员打开大门时，那只小狼躲到了一段木头后面。

entries.en: The wolf fish swam behind the tank's central rock before I could photograph it.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及拍照，那条狼鳚就游到了水族箱中央的岩石后面。

entries.en: A wolf spider crawled across the paving stone beside my empty gardening boot.
entries.zh: 一只狼蛛爬过了我那只空园艺靴旁的铺路石。

entries.en: Wolf's bane had grown around the base of the neglected garden seat.
entries.zh: 乌头已经长在了那张疏于照管的花园座椅底座周围。

entries.en: Wolfram steel offcuts filled the metal bin beneath the cutting machine.
entries.zh: 切割机下方的金属箱里装满了钨钢边角料。

entries.en: The wood anemone remained undamaged after the fallen sign was lifted away.
entries.zh: 倒下的标牌抬走后，那株五叶银莲花仍然完好无损。

entries.en: A wood ant climbed over the buckle of the backpack I had left on the ground.
entries.zh: 一只红褐林蚁爬过了我放在地上那个背包的搭扣。

entries.en: The wood duck swam beneath the bridge as we waited for the rain to stop.
entries.zh: 我们等雨停时，那只林鸳鸯从桥下游过。

entries.en: The wood hoopoe shifted to another branch when the camera shutter clicked.
entries.zh: 相机快门响起时，那只林戴胜换到了另一根树枝上。

entries.en: The wood ibis stepped around the bucket the keeper had left beside the gate.
entries.zh: 那只林鹳绕过了饲养员留在门旁的桶。

entries.en: The carpenter swept the wood shavings away before unfolding the new plans.
entries.zh: 木匠扫走刨花，才展开新的图纸。

entries.en: The gardener rescued the wood strawberry from beneath the overturned flowerpot.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株野草莓从翻倒的花盆下面救了出来。

entries.en: A wood warbler perched above the bench where we had stopped to rest.
entries.zh: 一只林柳莺停在我们休息的长凳上方。

entries.en: The nursery replaced the woody plant that had arrived with a broken stem.
entries.zh: 苗圃换掉了那株送达时茎已折断的木本植物。

entries.en: The technician cleaned the spilled wool grease from the weighing tray.
entries.zh: 技术员清理了洒在称量盘上的羊毛脂。

entries.en: The spinner returned the tin of wool oil to its shelf after the shift.
entries.zh: 下班后，纺纱工把那罐羊毛油放回了搁板。

entries.en: The student photographed the woolly alder aphid through the microscope's camera attachment.
entries.zh: 学生通过显微镜的相机附件拍下了那只赤杨绵蚜。

entries.en: The researcher moved the woolly aphid onto a clean observation slide.
entries.zh: 研究员把那只绵蚜移到了一片干净的观察载玻片上。

entries.en: The inspector found a woolly apple aphid on the sample taken from the orchard.
entries.zh: 检查员在从果园采来的样品上发现了一只苹绵蚜。

entries.en: A woolly bear crawled across the handle of a trowel the gardener had left on the ground.
entries.zh: 一只灯蛾毛虫爬过了园丁搁在地上的小铲子的手柄。

entries.meaningZh: 灯蛾科幼虫〔传统分类称呼〕
entries.en: The woolly bear caterpillar disappeared beneath the folded corner of the empty carton.
entries.zh: 那只灯蛾科幼虫钻到了空纸箱折起的一角下面。

entries.en: The woolly mammoth model barely fitted through the museum's loading entrance.
entries.zh: 那具毛象模型勉强通过了博物馆的装卸入口。

entries.en: The woolly monkey stretched an arm towards the empty feeding platform as the keeper approached.
entries.zh: 饲养员走近时，那只绒毛猴把一只手臂伸向空着的喂食平台。

entries.en: The museum's woolly rhinoceros model was too tall to pass through the doorway.
entries.zh: 博物馆的那具披毛犀模型太高，无法通过门口。

entries.en: The farmer led the tired work animal back to the shaded yard.
entries.zh: 农民把那头疲惫的役畜牵回了阴凉的院子。

entries.en: A worker bee landed on the handle of the beekeeper's empty basket.
entries.zh: 一只工蜂落在了养蜂人空篮子的提手上。

entries.en: The shepherd called the working dog back from the gate.
entries.zh: 牧羊人把那只牧羊犬从门边叫了回来。

entries.en: The tiny worm snake slithered beneath a piece of bark in the observation tank.
entries.zh: 那条盲蛇科的小蛇爬到了观察箱里的一片树皮下面。

entries.en: Wormwood oil leaked from a cracked bottle onto the cupboard shelf.
entries.zh: 苦艾油从一个开裂的瓶子里漏出，洒在了橱柜搁板上。
